MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineExtended.lean:141:/-- The `X` block of an extended point transported to the source scalar field
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineExtended.lean:142:is the transport of its `X` block.  Blueprint

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:4:# Placement calculus on the expanded state
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:6:This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:7:combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:8:opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:9:pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:10:to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:11:state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:12:`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:13:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:14:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:15:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:16:The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:17:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1003-1030`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:18:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.  The
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:19:EPR-exchange invariance is the element `U_σ U_θ` of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:20:`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`, blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:21:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1032-1130`, which needs no
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:22:symmetry of the strategy; its use for `lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:23:`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/PlacementSupport.lean:24:-/

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:4:# Reshuffling products of finitely supported laws
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:6:The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma produces its six independent
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:7:generating blocks in one grouping, while the restricted line-point laws that
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:8:the projected marginals must match present the same six blocks in another
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:9:grouping.  This module records the rewriting rules that pass between two such
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:10:presentations: the support and the weight of a product, the fact that a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:11:push-forward along a bijection is determined by the supports and weights it
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:12:compares, and the push-forward of the second factor of a product.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:13:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:14:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:15:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:16:The rewriting rules support `lem:qld-sublines` in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:17:blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:18:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:19:The product operation is that of blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineShuffle.lean:20:`def:line-point-dist`.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:4:# Generating laws of the restricted line-point distributions
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:6:This module rewrites the two restricted line-point laws of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:7:`def:ith-restricted-line` as push-forwards of a single uniformly sampled
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:8:low-degree vector conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber of its retained
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:9:scalar seed.  In that form the point block, the seed and the direction block
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:10:of the sampled vector are visibly the independent generating data of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:11:restricted law, which is the description used by the sampling procedure of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:12:sub-line lemma: there the projected pairs are built either from a direction
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:13:block inherited from the extended line or from freshly sampled data, and each
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:14:is asserted to follow a restricted law.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:15:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:16:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:17:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:18:The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:19:blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:20:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:21:The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineSupport.lean:22:1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:4:/-!
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:5:# The combined parameters of the simultaneity reduction
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:6:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:7:The extension of the quantum soundness of the low individual degree test from
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:8:simultaneity parameter `1` to a general simultaneity parameter `k` applies the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:9:case `k = 1` once, to a directly indexed low-degree game whose dimension is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:10:`m + k` and whose simultaneity parameter is `1`.  This module records that
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:11:parameter map, the polynomial-tuple outcomes it carries, and the two maps
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:12:relating outcomes of the two games: the combining map, which sends a tuple of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:13:`k` polynomials in `m` variables to the one-component tuple consisting of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:14:combined polynomial in `m + k` variables, and its total left inverse, which
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:15:returns the components of a combined polynomial and an arbitrary tuple
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:16:otherwise.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:17:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:18:The field, the degree, and the admissibility of the field size are inherited
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:19:unchanged; only the dimension and the simultaneity parameter change.  The
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:20:degree is inherited because the combining map is linear in the fresh
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:21:coordinates, so it raises no individual degree above `d` when `1 ≤ d`; this is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:22:where the individual-degree formulation differs from the total-degree
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:23:formulation of the source, which passes from degree `d` to degree `d + 1`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:24:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:25:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:26:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:27:* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:28:* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:29:* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:240-250`

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:31:-/

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:43:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:44:/-- The parameters of the game to which the reduction applies the case of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:45:simultaneity parameter `1`: the dimension grows from `m` to `m + k` and the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:46:simultaneity parameter becomes `1`, while the field size, the degree, and the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:47:admissibility hypothesis are unchanged. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:48:def DirectLdParams.combined (D : DirectLdParams) : DirectLdParams where
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:49:  q := D.q
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:50:  m := D.m + D.k
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:51:  d := D.d
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:52:  k := 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:53:  hm := le_trans D.hm (Nat.le_add_right D.m D.k)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:54:  hd := D.hd
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:55:  hk := le_refl 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:56:  hq := D.hq
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:57:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:58:@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_q (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:59:    D.combined.q = D.q := rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:60:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:61:@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_m (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:62:    D.combined.m = D.m + D.k := rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:63:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:64:@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_d (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:65:    D.combined.d = D.d := rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:66:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:67:@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_k (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:68:    D.combined.k = 1 := rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:69:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:70:/-- The combined parameters carry the same scalar field: the field model is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:71:selected by the field size and its admissibility proof, both unchanged. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:72:theorem directScalarQ_combined (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:73:    DirectScalarQ D.combined = DirectScalarQ D := rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:74:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:75:/-- The scalar field of a directly indexed low-degree game has `q` elements. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:76:theorem card_directScalarQ (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:77:    Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) = D.q := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:78:  rw [Fintype.card_congr (binaryRepresentation D.model), Fintype.card_fin]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:79:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:80:/-- The one-element index set of the combined simultaneity parameter. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:81:instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Unique (Fin D.combined.k) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:82:  show Unique (Fin 1) from inferInstance
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:83:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:84:/-! ## The combining map on game outcomes -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:85:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:86:/-- The combined polynomial of a tuple of direct polynomial representatives:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:87:`(u, α) ↦ ∑_{r < k} α_r g_r(u)`, of individual degree at most `d` in the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:88:`m + k` variables of the combined parameters.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:89:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:90:Source `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1425-1435`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:91:def directCombinedPolynomial (D : DirectLdParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:92:    PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:93:  ⟨combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1),
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:94:    combinePolyTuple_mem_polyFunc D.hd _ fun r => (g r).2⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:95:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:96:@[simp] theorem directCombinedPolynomial_val (D : DirectLdParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:97:    (directCombinedPolynomial D g).1 = combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:98:  rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:99:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:100:/-- Evaluating the combined polynomial at a point of the combined space with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:101:point part `u` and combining part `α` gives `∑_{r < k} α_r g_r(u)`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:102:theorem directCombinedPolynomial_eval (D : DirectLdParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple D)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:103:    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (α : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:104:    MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) (directCombinedPolynomial D g).1 =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:105:      ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * evalDirectPolyTupleAt u g r := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:106:  rw [directCombinedPolynomial_val, combinePolyTuple_eval_combinedPoint]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:107:  rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:108:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:109:/-- The combining map is injective on polynomial tuples. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:110:theorem directCombinedPolynomial_injective (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:111:    Function.Injective (directCombinedPolynomial D) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:112:  intro g g' h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:113:  have hval : combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:114:      combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g' r).1) := congrArg Subtype.val h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:115:  have hcomp := combinePolyTuple_injective hval
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:116:  funext r
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:117:  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun hcomp r)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:118:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:119:/-- The one-component polynomial tuple of the combined game carrying the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:120:combined polynomial of a tuple. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:121:def directCombinedTuple (D : DirectLdParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:122:    DirectPolyTuple D.combined :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:123:  fun _ => directCombinedPolynomial D g

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:130:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:131:/-- A polynomial in the variables of the combined parameters is combined when it
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:132:is the combined polynomial of a tuple.  This is the source's exact linearity in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:133:the combining variables, together with the individual-degree bound on the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:134:components.  Source
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:135:`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1462-1477`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:136:def IsDirectCombined (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:137:    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d) : Prop :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:138:  ∃ g : DirectPolyTuple D, directCombinedPolynomial D g = p
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:139:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:140:theorem isDirectCombined_directCombinedPolynomial (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:141:    (g : DirectPolyTuple D) : IsDirectCombined D (directCombinedPolynomial D g) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:142:  ⟨g, rfl⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:143:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:144:/-- The polynomial tuple represented by a polynomial in the variables of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:145:combined parameters: its components when it is combined, and the zero tuple
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:146:otherwise.  The source leaves the value on non-combined outcomes arbitrary; the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:147:zero tuple is one admissible choice, and the estimates use only the value on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:148:combined outcomes.  Source
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:149:`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1477-1483`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:150:def directTupleOfCombined (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:151:    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d) : DirectPolyTuple D := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:152:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:153:  exact if h : IsDirectCombined D p then h.choose else fun _ => 0
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:154:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:155:/-- The components of a combined polynomial are the tuple it combines. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:156:@[simp] theorem directTupleOfCombined_directCombinedPolynomial (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:157:    (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:158:    directTupleOfCombined D (directCombinedPolynomial D g) = g := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:159:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:160:  have hex : IsDirectCombined D (directCombinedPolynomial D g) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:161:    isDirectCombined_directCombinedPolynomial D g
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:162:  rw [directTupleOfCombined, dif_pos hex]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:163:  exact directCombinedPolynomial_injective D hex.choose_spec
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:164:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:165:/-- The polynomial tuple represented by an outcome of the combined game. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:166:def directTupleOfCombinedTuple (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:167:    (p : DirectPolyTuple D.combined) : DirectPolyTuple D :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:168:  directTupleOfCombined D (p default)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:169:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:170:@[simp] theorem directTupleOfCombinedTuple_directCombinedTuple (D : DirectLdParams)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:171:    (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:172:    directTupleOfCombinedTuple D (directCombinedTuple D g) = g := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:173:  rw [directTupleOfCombinedTuple, directCombinedTuple_apply,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:174:    directTupleOfCombined_directCombinedPolynomial]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:175:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Parameters.lean:176:end

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:1:import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Transport.Combining.Recovery
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:2:import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Sandwich
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:3:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:4:/-!
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:5:# Transporting a consistency relation along the recovery step
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:6:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:7:The recovery step of `lem:ld-combining-recovery` replaces a relation between a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:8:point measurement of the original strategy read through a combination and a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:9:measurement of the combined game read at a point of the combined space by a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:10:relation between the point measurement itself and the same measurement read
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:11:through the recovered polynomial tuple.  This module isolates the consistency
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:12:calculus of that replacement, in a form which does not mention the low-degree
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:13:game.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:14:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:15:Both relations are diagonal overlaps of the same pair of measurements placed on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:16:opposite tensor factors, and the two relabellings differ only on the event that
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:17:the recovered outcome disagrees with the outcome of the point measurement while
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:18:the two relabellings agree.  The probability of that event, averaged over the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:19:auxiliary sample, is bounded at each question by a quantity depending only on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:20:the outcome of the second measurement; since the first measurement is complete,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:21:the total Born weight of an outcome of the second measurement does not depend on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:22:the question, and the bound may therefore be averaged over the question against
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:23:that weight.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:24:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:25:The two conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness` transported here place the point
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:26:measurement on opposite tensor factors, so the calculus is recorded twice, once
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:27:for each placement; the two statements share the averaging estimate, which is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:28:insensitive to the placement.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:29:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryDefect.lean:30:## Main statements

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:4:# Exact linearity in the combining variables
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:6:The recovery step of the combining reduction needs to know that a polynomial in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:7:the combined variables which is not the combined polynomial of any tuple only
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:8:rarely restricts to a linear form in the combining variables: writing
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:9:`p = ∑_μ c_μ α^μ` with coefficients `c_μ` in the point variables, the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:10:polynomial `p` is combined exactly when `c_μ` vanishes for every exponent vector
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:11:`μ` outside the `k` standard basis vectors, and the restriction `p(u, ·)` is a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:12:linear form exactly when `c_μ(u)` vanishes for every such `μ`.  Fixing one such
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:13:`μ` with `c_μ ≠ 0`, whose total degree is at most `m d`, the Schwartz--Zippel
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/ExactLinearity.lean:14:lemma bounds the probability of `c_μ(u) = 0` by `m d / q`.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:4:# The combining map on tuples of low individual degree polynomials
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:6:The extension of the quantum soundness of the low individual degree test from
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:7:simultaneity parameter `1` to a general simultaneity parameter `k` is obtained
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:8:in the source by a reduction, not coordinatewise: the `k` answer polynomials
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:9:`g_0, …, g_{k-1}` in `m` variables are combined into the single polynomial
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:10:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:11:`comb(g)(u, α) = ∑_{r < k} α_r g_r(u)`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:12:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:13:in `m + k` variables, the case `k = 1` is applied once in dimension `m + k`,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:14:and the `k` polynomials are recovered from the resulting outcome by exact
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:15:linearity in the combining variables `α` together with the Schwartz--Zippel
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:16:lemma.  This module develops the polynomial algebra of that combining map: the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:17:coordinate split of `Fin (m + k)`, the map itself, its evaluation identity, its
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:18:individual-degree bound, and the substitution recovering the `r`-th component,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:19:which exhibits the map as injective.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:20:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:21:The combining map of `def:combine-map` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Defs.lean`)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:22:is the special case of two components used by the Chapter 15 combining
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:23:argument, written there in the fixed coordinate layout of that chapter; the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:24:present map is the general `k`-component form required by the reduction, in the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:25:coordinate layout of the directly indexed low-degree game, where the `m` point
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:26:coordinates precede the `k` combining coordinates.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:27:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:54:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:55:/-- The point coordinates of the combined dimension `m + k`.  The `m` point
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:56:coordinates come first, so that zeroing a prefix of a direction of the combined
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:57:space restricts to zeroing the corresponding prefix of its point part. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:58:def combinedPointVar (m k : ℕ) (j : Fin m) : Fin (m + k) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:59:  finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl j)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:60:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:61:/-- The combining coordinates of the combined dimension `m + k`.  Coordinate
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:62:`combinedCoefficientVar m k r` carries the scalar `α_r` multiplying the `r`-th
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:63:component of a polynomial tuple. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:64:def combinedCoefficientVar (m k : ℕ) (r : Fin k) : Fin (m + k) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:65:  finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr r)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:66:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:67:theorem combinedPointVar_injective (m k : ℕ) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:68:    Function.Injective (combinedPointVar m k) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:69:  intro j j' h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:70:  simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:71:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:72:theorem combinedCoefficientVar_injective (m k : ℕ) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:73:    Function.Injective (combinedCoefficientVar m k) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:74:  intro r r' h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:75:  simpa using finSumFinEquiv.injective h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:76:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:77:/-- The two coordinate blocks of the combined dimension are disjoint. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:78:theorem combinedCoefficientVar_ne_combinedPointVar (m k : ℕ) (r : Fin k) (j : Fin m) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:79:    combinedCoefficientVar m k r ≠ combinedPointVar m k j := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:80:  intro h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:81:  have := finSumFinEquiv.injective h

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:85:    combinedCoefficientVar m k r ∉ Set.range (combinedPointVar m k) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:86:  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:87:  exact combinedCoefficientVar_ne_combinedPointVar m k r j hj.symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:88:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:89:/-- The point part of a point of the combined space. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:90:def combinedPointPart {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (z : Fin (m + k) → K) : Fin m → K :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:91:  fun j => z (combinedPointVar m k j)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:92:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:93:/-- The combining part of a point of the combined space. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:94:def combinedCoefficientPart {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (z : Fin (m + k) → K) : Fin k → K :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:95:  fun r => z (combinedCoefficientVar m k r)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:96:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:97:/-- The point of the combined space with the given point and combining parts. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:98:def combinedPoint {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (u : Fin m → K) (α : Fin k → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:99:    Fin (m + k) → K :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:100:  fun i => Sum.elim u α (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:103:    (u : Fin m → K) (α : Fin k → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:104:    combinedPointPart (combinedPoint u α) = u := by

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:108:@[simp] theorem combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:109:    (u : Fin m → K) (α : Fin k → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:110:    combinedCoefficientPart (combinedPoint u α) = α := by

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:114:/-! ## The combining map -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:115:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:116:/-- The combining map of the reduction: the tuple `g` is sent to the polynomial
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:117:`(u, α) ↦ ∑_{r < k} α_r g_r(u)` in `m + k` variables.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:118:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:119:Source `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1425-1435`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:120:def combinePolyTuple {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m k : ℕ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:121:    (g : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + k)) K :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:122:  ∑ r : Fin k, MvPolynomial.X (combinedCoefficientVar m k r) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:123:    MvPolynomial.rename (combinedPointVar m k) (g r)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:124:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:125:/-- Evaluation of a combined polynomial is the displayed combining formula. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:126:theorem combinePolyTuple_eval {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m k : ℕ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:127:    (g : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) (z : Fin (m + k) → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:128:    MvPolynomial.eval z (combinePolyTuple g) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:129:      ∑ r : Fin k, combinedCoefficientPart z r *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:130:        MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPointPart z) (g r) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:131:  simp only [combinePolyTuple, map_sum, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:132:    MvPolynomial.eval_rename, combinedCoefficientPart]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:133:  rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:134:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:135:/-- Evaluation of a combined polynomial at a point given by its two blocks. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:136:theorem combinePolyTuple_eval_combinedPoint {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m k : ℕ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:137:    (g : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) (u : Fin m → K) (α : Fin k → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:138:    MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) (combinePolyTuple g) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:139:      ∑ r : Fin k, α r * MvPolynomial.eval u (g r) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:140:  rw [combinePolyTuple_eval, combinedPointPart_combinedPoint,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:141:    combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:142:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:143:/-! ## Recovering the components -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:144:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:145:/-- The substitution sending each point coordinate to its own variable and the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:146:combining coordinates to the `r`-th standard basis vector.  Applied to a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:147:combined polynomial it returns the `r`-th component of the tuple. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:148:def combinedSubstitution (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] (m k : ℕ) (r : Fin k) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:149:    Fin (m + k) → MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:150:  fun i => Sum.elim (fun j : Fin m => MvPolynomial.X j)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:151:    (fun s : Fin k => if s = r then 1 else 0) (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:152:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:153:@[simp] theorem combinedSubstitution_point (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K] (m k : ℕ)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:154:    (r : Fin k) (j : Fin m) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:155:    combinedSubstitution K m k r (combinedPointVar m k j) = MvPolynomial.X j := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:156:  simp [combinedSubstitution, combinedPointVar]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/Polynomial.lean:157:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:3:/-!
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:4:# Branch-wise acceptance transport for the combined strategy
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:6:By `directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le`, the branch-wise estimates of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:7:`lem:ld-combined-value` reduce to the following statement: the relabelling of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:8:`def:ld-combined-strategy` sends an answer pair accepted by the win predicate
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:9:of the original game at the measured questions to an answer pair accepted by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:10:the win predicate of the combined game.  This module proves that statement for
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:11:each of the nine ordered type pairs of the combined game.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:12:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:13:Three of the nine branches are deterministic.  The two questions of a branch
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:14:whose type pair is diagonal are equal, so the acceptance clause of the original
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:15:game forces the two measured outcomes to be equal, and the relabelling, being a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:16:function, sends them to equal combined outcomes.  The two branches pairing an
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:17:axis-parallel line with a diagonal line impose no condition in either game.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:18:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:19:The six remaining branches pair a line with a point, and split according to
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:20:whether the stored coordinate index of the common sample is a point coordinate
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:21:or a combining coordinate.  On a point coordinate the acceptance clause of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:22:combined game is obtained from the acceptance clause of the original game by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:23:the affine change of parameter `directCombinedRebaseParameter`: the parameter
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:24:presenting the sampled point on the sampled line of the combined space presents
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:25:the point part of the sampled point on the image line, after the shift.  On a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:26:combining coordinate the sampled line lies in a fiber of the projection to the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:27:point coordinates, the combining part of the sampled point is the affine
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:28:function `α₀ + t w` of the parameter, and the acceptance clause of the combined
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:29:game is the identity `∑ r (α₀ + t w)_r b_r = ∑ r α_r b_r`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:30:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/WinPredicate.lean:31:All declarations below are formalization-only support for

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:8:`lem:ld-combining-recovery` turns the three conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:9:for the combined strategy at the combined parameters into the three conclusions
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:10:for the original strategy at the original parameters, by post-processing the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:11:measurements of the combined game with the recovery map of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:12:`def:ld-combining-map`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:13:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:14:The two point relations follow from the consistency-defect transport
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:15:inequality.  At a point `(u, α)` of the combined space the point measurement of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:16:the combined strategy is the point measurement of the original strategy at `u`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:17:post-processed by the combination with coefficients `α`, and the polynomial
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:18:measurement of the combined game read at that point is the same measurement
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:19:read through the recovery map and then combined with the same coefficients; the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:20:two families therefore differ only on the recovery discrepancy event, whose
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:21:average is `(m + k) d / q`.  The uniform law on the combined space is the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:22:product of the uniform laws on the point part and on the combining part, which
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:23:is the reindexing along
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:24:`directCombinedPointEquiv`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:25:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:26:The polynomial relation is data processing: the recovered measurements are
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/RecoveryTransport.lean:27:post-processings of the measurements of the combined game.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:3:/-!
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:4:# The questions measured by the combined strategy
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:6:`lem:ld-combined-question-law` identifies the pair of questions measured by the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:7:combined strategy of `def:ld-combined-strategy` on a sample of the combined
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:8:game.  The coordinate index of the common sample is uniform on the `m + k`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:9:coordinates of the combined dimension, and the identification splits according
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:10:to whether that index is a point coordinate or a combining coordinate.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:11:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:12:On a point coordinate `j`, all three question types measure the canonical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:13:question of the same type of the original game attached to the *projected*
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:14:sample `directCombinedSampleProjection`: the point part of the sampled point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:15:the index `j`, and the point part of the sampled direction.  This uses the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:16:coordinate order of `def:ld-combining-map`: the point coordinates precede the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:17:combining coordinates, so the coordinate direction of a point coordinate has
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:18:point part the corresponding coordinate direction, and the prefix projection at
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:19:a point coordinate restricts to the prefix projection at that coordinate of the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:20:point part.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:21:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:22:On a combining coordinate, every direction produced by the question
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:23:distribution has vanishing point part, so all three question types measure the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:24:point question at the point part of the sampled point.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:25:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:26:The projected sample is read from the *canonical* base of the combined line,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:27:which need not project to the canonical base of the image line; the two agree
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:28:after rebasing along the image direction, which is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:29:`lineRepMap_directCombinedPointPart_lineRepMap`.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:157:def directCombinedSampleProjection (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:158:    (sample : DirectLdSpace D.combined) : DirectLdSpace D :=

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:163:index is the point coordinate `j`, the combined strategy measures, for every
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:164:question type, the canonical question of that type of the original game

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:167:    (t : LdType) (j : Fin D.m) (sample : DirectLdSpace D.combined)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:168:    (hindex : sample.index = combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) :

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:186:      rw [directCombinedPointPart_directPrefixProjection_pointVar] at hbase
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:187:      simp only [directLdMap, directCombinedMeasuredQuestion, hindex,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:188:        directCombinedIndexSplit_combinedPointVar,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:189:        directCombinedSampleProjection,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:190:        directCombinedPointPart_directPrefixProjection_pointVar,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:191:        directPrefixProjection_idem]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:192:      exact congrArg (fun x : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:193:        ((LdType.dline, ⟨x, j,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:194:          directPrefixProjection j

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:196:          DirectLdQuestion D)) hbase
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:197:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:198:/-- Second half of `lem:ld-combined-question-law`: on a sample whose coordinate
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:199:index is a combining coordinate, every direction produced by the question
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:200:distribution has vanishing point part, so the combined strategy measures, for
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:201:every question type, the point question at the point part of the sampled

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:204:    (t : LdType) (r : Fin D.k) (sample : DirectLdSpace D.combined)

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:220:        (directPrefixProjection (combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r) sample.direction)

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:222:        (directCombinedPointPart_directPrefixProjection_coefficientVar D r

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:226:      exact congrArg (fun x : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D =>

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:229:/-! ## The law of the projected sample -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:230:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:231:/-- A point of the combined space is recovered from its two parts. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:232:@[simp] theorem combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:233:    {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (z : Fin (m + k) → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:234:    combinedPoint (combinedPointPart z) (combinedCoefficientPart z) = z := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:235:  funext i
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:236:  rw [combinedPoint]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:237:  rcases hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | r
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:238:  · show combinedPointPart z j = z i
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:239:    rw [combinedPointPart, combinedPointVar, ← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:240:  · show combinedCoefficientPart z r = z i
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:241:    rw [combinedCoefficientPart, combinedCoefficientVar, ← hi,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:242:      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:243:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:244:/-- The decomposition of a sample of the combined game into its two point
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:245:parts, its two combining parts, and its coordinate index. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:246:private def directCombinedSpaceEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:247:    DirectLdSpace D.combined ≃
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:248:      (((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:249:        (((Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:250:          Fin D.combined.m)) where
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:251:  toFun sample :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:252:    ((directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:253:        directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction),
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:254:      ((directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:255:        directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.direction), sample.index))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:256:  invFun x :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:257:    ⟨combinedPoint x.1.1 x.2.1.1, x.2.2, combinedPoint x.1.2 x.2.1.2⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:258:  left_inv sample := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:259:    obtain ⟨point, index, direction⟩ := sample
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:260:    dsimp only
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:261:    congr 1 <;>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:262:      first
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:263:        | rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:264:        | exact combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:265:  right_inv x := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:266:    obtain ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨α, w⟩, i⟩ := x
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:267:    dsimp only
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:268:    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:269:    exact ⟨⟨combinedPointPart_combinedPoint u α,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:270:        combinedPointPart_combinedPoint v w⟩,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:271:      ⟨combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint u α,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:272:        combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint v w⟩, trivial⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:273:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:274:/-- The distributional half of `lem:ld-combined-question-law`: the two point
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:275:parts of a uniform sample of the combined game are jointly uniform, hence
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:276:independent of the combining parts and of the coordinate index.  Together with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:277:`directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar` this says that, conditioned on a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:278:point coordinate index, the questions measured by the combined strategy are the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:279:canonical questions of a uniform sample of the original game. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:280:theorem directCombinedSample_pointParts_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:281:    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D.combined)).map
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:282:        (fun sample => (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:283:          directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction)) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:284:      uniformDistribution
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:285:        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:286:  uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (e := directCombinedSpaceEquiv D) _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:287:    fun _ => rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:288:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:289:/-- The coordinate index of a uniform sample of the combined game is uniform on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:290:the `m + k` coordinates of the combined dimension; this is the index of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:291:`lem:ld-combined-question-law`, whose two cases are the point coordinates and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:292:the combining coordinates. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:293:theorem directCombinedSample_index_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:294:    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D.combined)).map
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:295:        (fun sample => sample.index) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:296:      uniformDistribution (Fin D.combined.m) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:297:  uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (e := directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D.combined)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:298:    _ fun _ => rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:299:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:300:/-- The decomposition of a sample of the combined game into its coordinate
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:301:index and its two point parts on the one side, and its two combining parts on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:302:the other. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:303:private def directCombinedSpaceIndexEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:304:    DirectLdSpace D.combined ≃
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:305:      ((Fin D.combined.m ×
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:306:          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))) ×
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:307:        ((Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D))) where
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:308:  toFun sample :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:309:    ((sample.index,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:310:        (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:311:          directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction)),
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:312:      (directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.point,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:313:        directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.direction))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/QuestionLaw.lean:314:  invFun x := ⟨combinedPoint x.1.2.1 x.2.1, x.1.1, combinedPoint x.1.2.2 x.2.2⟩

     4	/-!
     5	# Error inflation of restricted line-point averages
     6	
     7	This module records how a nonnegative average over the line-point distribution
     8	transfers to one restricted component.  The line-point law places weight
     9	`1 / 2` on each of its two kinds and, inside each kind, weight `1 / m` on each
    10	coordinate index, so every restricted component carries mixture weight
    11	`1 / (2 m)` and a nonnegative average inflates by at most `2 m`.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	The estimates are items 1 and 2 of blueprint
    16	`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, formalizing the unlabelled estimates at
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1052-1058`.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	open scoped BigOperators
    21	
    22	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    23	
    24	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	/-! ## Averages of the distribution operations -/
    29	
    30	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: an average against a dependent bind is the
    95	  change (∑ p ∈ μ.support ×ˢ ν.support, μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2 * f p) = _
    96	  rw [Finset.sum_product]
    97	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    98	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    99	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
   100	
   101	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: one component of a uniform mixture carries at
   102	most the whole nonnegative average, scaled by its mixture weight.  Blueprint
   103	`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
   104	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1052-1056`. -/
   105	theorem avgOver_bind_uniform_component_le {ι β : Type*}
   106	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq β]
   107	    (ν : ι → Distribution β) (f : β → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, 0 ≤ f b) (i : ι) :
   108	    1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * avgOver (ν i) f ≤
   109	      avgOver (Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution ι) ν) f := by
   110	  classical
   111	  rw [avgOver_bind]
   112	  have hterm : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
   113	      0 ≤ (uniformDistribution ι).weight j * avgOver (ν j) f := fun j _ =>
   114	    mul_nonneg ((uniformDistribution ι).nonnegative j) (avgOver_nonneg _ _ hf)
   115	  have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum
   116	    (f := fun j => (uniformDistribution ι).weight j * avgOver (ν j) f)
   117	    hterm (Finset.mem_univ i)
   118	  rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply] at hsingle
   119	  exact hsingle

   123	/-- Restricting a nonnegative line-point average to one kind and one coordinate
   124	index inflates it by at most `2 m`.  This is the pointwise form of item 1 of
   125	blueprint `lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
   126	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1052-1056`. -/

   128	    (f : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) → ℝ)
   129	    (hf : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ f sample) (kind : LineKind) (i : Fin P.m) :

   138	    avgOver_nonneg _ _ hf
   139	  have hDnonneg : 0 ≤ avgOver (dLinePointDist P.toLdParams) f :=
   140	    avgOver_nonneg _ _ hf

   178	\section{What the cited soundness theorem requires: the import obligations}
   179	\label{sec:import-obligations}
   180	
   181	The quantum soundness theorem for the classical game inherits the constraint
   182	$m' \mid q$ solely because it is stated for the game just described; its
   183	proof fixes an admissible $q$ with $m' \mid q$, asserts that the game with
   184	simultaneity parameter $1$ is \emph{identical} to the two-prover tensor-code

   186	authors' \emph{Quantum soundness of testing tensor codes} (arXiv:2111.08131)
   187	\cite{Ji2021Quantum}, and concludes by Theorem~4.7 there, instantiated with
   188	that theorem's auxiliary integer parameter --- denoted $k$ in that source,

   190	simultaneity parameter --- chosen as $(m')^3 d$.  Neither
   191	the asserted identity nor the instantiation is complete as stated, so the
   192	import carries two verification obligations, which this section details and

   195	the divisibility question and remain open for that route at every dimension

   197	soundness of the directly indexed game by the same tensor-code import.  The

   201	\paragraph{The cited test.}
   202	In the two-prover tensor-code test (Figures~1 and~2 of
   203	\cite{Ji2021Quantum}; the two-prover strategy format and the goodness
   204	measure are Definitions~4.5 and~4.6 there), the referee performs one of
   205	three subtests with probability $1/3$ each, assigning the two roles of each
   206	subtest to the two provers uniformly at random.  \emph{Axis-parallel lines
   207	test}: sample a uniform point $u \in [n]^{m'}$ and a uniform axis
   208	$j \in \{1,\ldots,m'\}$; send the axis-parallel line $\ell$ through $u$ in
   209	direction $j$ to one prover, who answers a codeword $g \in \mathcal C$;
   210	send $u$ to the other, who answers a field value $a$; accept iff
   211	$g(u_j) = a$.  \emph{Subcube commutation test}: sample
   212	$j \in \{1,\ldots,m'\}$ and a subcube $H \subseteq [n]^{m'}$ by fixing the
   213	last $j-1$ coordinates uniformly; sample $u, v$ independently and uniformly
   214	in $H$ and a uniform order bit; send the ordered pair $(u,v)$ or $(v,u)$ to
   215	one prover, who answers a pair $(b_u, b_v)$ of field values; send $u$ to
   216	the other, who answers $a$; accept iff $b_u = a$.  \emph{Synchronicity
   217	test}: send one identical question --- a line, a point, or an ordered
   218	pair, with probability $1/3$ each --- to both provers and accept iff their
   219	answers agree.  Theorem~4.7 supposes a two-prover strategy passing this
   220	test with probability $1-\eps$ together with an integer parameter
   221	$K \ge 12 m' t$, where $t$ is the interpolation parameter of the base code

   226	lines measurements, and with each other, up to

   228	\mathrm{poly}(\eps, n^{-1}, e^{-K/(m')^2})$.

   231	The source asserts that the $\chi$-based game at parameters $(q,m',d,1)$

   234	two points of a \emph{hidden} subcube --- the subcube itself is not sent
